name: Coagulation and fibrinolysis with FXII contact activation
rationale: All members concern blood clot formation, fibrin regulation or its dissolution; the FXII/kallikrein contact system (including hereditary angioedema and amyloid-triggered FXII) and fibrinolysis distinguish it from confusables built on FV, FVIII/FIX and VWF variant defects.

name: Embryonic eye morphogenesis and retinal neuron differentiation
rationale: Members cover optic cup, iris, eyelid and optic nerve morphogenesis plus differentiation of rod, bipolar, amacrine and ganglion cells, distinguishing it from confusables centred on lens/cornea, ocular vasculature or phototransduction and retinoid metabolism.

name: Mitochondrial proteolysis and calcium uniporter regulation
rationale: All members concern intramitochondrial protein processing/catabolism or mitochondrial calcium uptake (including SMDT1/EMRE processing), which sets it apart from confusables on mitochondrial protein import, targeting and cristae formation.

name: Branched-chain alpha-oxidation and short/medium-chain acyl-CoA metabolism
rationale: Members share short/medium-chain and branched (phytanate, pristanoyl) acyl-CoA handling with malonyl/succinyl-CoA metabolism; phytanate alpha-oxidation and short-chain catabolism distinguish it from confusables on mitochondrial beta-oxidation/carnitine, VLCFA peroxisomal beta-oxidation and choline/threonine catabolism.

qualifier: FGFR, PDGFR and ALK/LTK fusions and amplifications
name: Oncogenic FGFR, PDGFR and ALK/LTK fusions and amplifications
rationale: All members are cancer-associated FGFR1-3, PDGFRA/B, ALK or LTK fusions, amplifications or mutants, distinguishing it from confusables on KIT and drug-resistant mutants or EGFR/ERBB2 variants.

name: Oxygen deprivation and hydrogen sulfide responses
rationale: The three members concern ischemia, oxygen metabolism and the gasotransmitter hydrogen sulfide, a loose oxygen/gas-sensing theme distinct from confusables on peroxide/nitrosative stress, oxidative-stress apoptosis and KATP channels.

name: Folate one-carbon metabolism and methionine synthase remethylation
rationale: Members cover folate/pterin, formate and THF interconversion plus MTR/MTRR-dependent methionine and sulfur amino acid synthesis; the folate one-carbon side distinguishes it from confusables centred on SAM, methionine salvage and choline catabolism.

name: Maternal-to-zygotic transition and maternal mRNA clearance
rationale: Members describe zygotic genome activation, MZT chromatin changes, cleavage and M-/Z-decay of maternal mRNAs via deadenylation, distinguishing it from germline piRNA/spermatogenesis confusables and general deadenylation regulation.

name: Nucleolar rRNA processing and snoRNP-guided methylation
rationale: Members span pre-rRNA cleavage, Pol I rRNA transcription and MYC-driven nucleolar genes plus box C/D snoRNP assembly and rRNA methylation, which distinguish it from confusables on ribosome assembly/export, RNA decay, or modification without processing.

name: Mitotic and meiotic chromosome condensation
rationale: Every member concerns chromosome condensation in prophase/prometaphase of mitosis or meiosis, distinct from confusables on sister chromatid cohesion, CENP-A deposition and meiotic segregation.

qualifier: DREAM and p53 repression of cell cycle genes
name: G2/M transition and checkpoint with DREAM/p53 gene repression
rationale: Members cover G2 phase, cyclin A/B-CDK1, PLK1, MASTL and Chk1/2 G2/M checkpoint plus p53/DREAM/p107-p130 repression of cell cycle genes, distinguishing it from APC/C mitotic exit and G1/S confusables.

name: Oxidative and dicarbonyl stress detoxification and protein repair
rationale: Members share defence against reactive oxygen species, reactive aldehydes/methylglyoxal and oxidative protein damage, distinguishing it from confusables on glutathione synthesis, vitamin B6/molybdenum cofactor and nitrosative stress.

name: Proximal TCR signaling and CTLA4/BTLA co-inhibition
rationale: Members cover CD3/zeta phosphorylation, ZAP-70 recruitment and T cell activation together with negative TCR regulation by CTLA4 and BTLA, distinguishing it from CD28 costimulation, BCR signaling and downstream TCR confusables.

name: Histone pre-mRNA 3'-end processing and snRNP biogenesis
rationale: Members share U snRNP-dependent RNA processing: stem-loop histone mRNA 3'-end formation, Pol II termination and snRNP assembly/cap hypermethylation/transport, distinguishing it from confusables on polyadenylation and mRNA export.

name: Cytosolic translation from 43S formation to elongation
rationale: All four members are ribosome-centred steps of cytoplasmic translation (free 40S pool, 43S complex, 60S joining, elongation), distinct from confusables on rRNA processing, translation termination/NMD and scanning/start-codon initiation.

name: Cytochrome P450 vitamin D and retinoic acid hydroxylation
rationale: Members concern vitamin D metabolism and disorders of CYP27B1/CYP24A1 plus CYP26B1/C1 retinoic acid hydroxylase defects, the CYP26 arm distinguishing it from phosphate/bone-mineralization and vitamin K confusables.

name: APC/C-Cdc20 and Cdh1 control of mitotic exit
rationale: All members concern APC/C activity, regulation and substrate degradation (cyclins, securin, Nek2A, Cdc20) during anaphase and mitotic exit, distinguishing it from confusables on spindle checkpoint, PLK1/Aurora and Emi1.

name: Immediate-early AP-1 response with AU-rich mRNA turnover
rationale: Members combine AP-1/NR4A immediate-early induction downstream of TNF/NF-kB and KRAS with ARE-binding proteins (TTP, AUF1, KSRP, BRF1, HuR) controlling mRNA stability, distinguishing it from translational-silencing, stress-granule and FOSL target confusables.

name: Kainate/AMPA excitation and Gbeta-gamma presynaptic inhibition
rationale: Members cover kainate and AMPA receptor activation, excitatory transmission and excitotoxicity plus Gbeta-gamma-mediated GIRK activation and Ca2+ channel inhibition, distinguishing it from presynaptic release, nicotinic and AMPA-trafficking confusables.

qualifier: telomerase-independent: C-strand replication, capping, ALT recombination
name: Telomerase-independent telomere replication, capping and recombination
rationale: Members cover telomere C-strand synthesis, capping/packaging and regulation of ALT recombination (ATRX/DAXX), distinguishing it from telomerase extension/Cajal body and general DNA repair confusables.

name: Early ectodermal epithelial morphogenesis
rationale: The three members (ectodermal differentiation, hair placode formation, lumen cavitation) share early epithelial morphogenesis of ectodermal origin, distinct from confusables on salivary branching, hair cycling and keratinocyte differentiation.

name: Microtubule organelle transport, mitochondrial distribution and endolysosome size
rationale: Members concern plus-end-directed microtubule transport of mitochondria and vesicles and endosome/lysosome size control, distinguishing it from neuronal cargo, tubulin-modification and lysosome-fusion confusables.

name: Amino sugar metabolism in N-glycosylation and lysosomal glycan breakdown
rationale: Members share hexosamine/UDP-GlcNAc and sialic acid metabolism feeding N-glycan processing and its lysosomal turnover (gangliosides, oligosaccharides, sialic acid storage), distinguishing it from O-glycan/fucose, GPI/glycosphingolipid synthesis and GAG-degradation confusables.

name: Golgi positioning, vesicle budding and membrane tubulation
rationale: Members concern Golgi localization (including KTN1), vesicle budding, constitutive secretion and endosomal membrane tubulation, distinguishing it from Golgi disassembly/reassembly, Rab/ARF regulation and endocytic recycling confusables.

name: CDC42-IQGAP control of leading-edge protrusion and adhesion
rationale: Members cover CDC42 and IQGAP regulation of lamellipodia, pseudopodia, actin polymerization, Rac/integrin signaling and focal adhesion turnover, distinguishing it from WASP/WAVE, invadopodia and macropinocytosis confusables.
